hero.title: Where Vision Meets Action
hero.subtitle: Visionary Youth Alliance brings together young people across Bangladesh to turn ideas into leadership, service, and change.

about.lead: Visionary Youth Alliance (VYA) is a youth-led organization dedicated to developing leadership, creativity, and civic responsibility among young people across Bangladesh — starting with ideas, and following through with action.

cards.title: Vision-led
cards.text: Every project starts with a clear goal and a plan to get there, not just an idea.

cards.title: Youth-led
cards.text: Run by young people, for young people — decisions made by the members who do the work.

cards.title: Community first
cards.text: Every initiative is measured by the real difference it makes in someone's life.

programs.lead: Our work is organized around a few clear commitments, not a long list of one-off activities.

pillars.title: Leadership Development
pillars.text: Workshops and mentorship that build confident, capable young leaders.

pillars.title: Community Service
pillars.text: Local projects that respond directly to needs in our own neighborhoods.

pillars.title: Skill-Building Events
pillars.text: Competitions, quizzes, and workshops that sharpen real, usable skills.

pillars.title: Campus Network
pillars.text: Ambassadors connecting students across schools and universities.

blog.title: Welcome to Visionary Youth Alliance
blog.author: VYA Team
blog.excerpt: A short introduction to why we started VYA and what we're building together.
blog.content:
We started Visionary Youth Alliance because we believe young people in Bangladesh deserve real opportunities to lead, not just participate.

This blog will be where we share updates, lessons learned, and stories from our programs. Stay tuned for more.

join.title: Ready to build something with us?
join.text: We're looking for founding members who want to lead, not just join.

faq.q: Who can join Visionary Youth Alliance?
faq.a: Any young person in Bangladesh who wants to learn, lead and serve. Students of schools, colleges and universities are all welcome.
No. Joining VYA and our core programs is free.
Press 'Apply to Join' at the bottom of the home page, fill in the short form, and our team will contact you.
Yes. Participants receive a certificate with a unique ID that anyone can check on our Verify page.

quotes.text: A vision without action is just a dream; action without vision is just noise. Be both.
Leadership begins the day you decide to serve someone other than yourself.
Small steps, taken together by many young hands, change a nation.
Faith is the bird that feels the light when the dawn is still dark.
Do not wait for permission to make a difference in your community.
Your age is not a limit — it is your launchpad.
It always seems impossible until it is done.
The strongest teams are built on trust, not titles.
Learn something new today, teach someone tomorrow.
Be the reason someone in your neighbourhood believes in tomorrow.
